threads.body: [Config] This reorder changes the result when a deployment sets conflicting versioned and versionless selectors: the versioned key now wins, whereas the versionless key won previously. Because this is an intentional 3.0 breaking configuration change, CONTRIBUTING.md requires an Unreleased breaking-change entry; please document the new precedence and the migration for configurations that set both aliases.

replies.body: going to ignore this, very unlikely to be issue in practice
